rules.delta_direction: variant minus FULL (a negative quality delta means the removal hurt)

materiality.note: |delta| > 0.2 on IDF1/HOTA/AssA/MOTA or |delta IDs| > 10, and resolved against the repeat ranges, counts as material; the 0.2 figure is the evidence ledger's decision-knob noise guidance, not a significance test

pair_reading.complement_dependency: I > +0.2: A's contribution needs B (or vice versa); removing both loses less than the sum
pair_reading.definition: I(A,B) = M(FULL) - M(FULL-A) - M(FULL-B) + M(FULL-A-B) on IDF1 and HOTA
pair_reading.substitute_backup: I < -0.2: each covers for the other; removing both loses more than the sum

rules.reference_rows: not subtractions: retuned or historical values quoted beside a subtraction to name its confound
rules.repeat_range: each side's same-session observed range (max-min over its runs); a delta is 'resolved' when |delta| exceeds the larger of the two sides' ranges and is above print precision; an observed range of 0.0 bounds nothing

runtime.identity: all seven MOT md5s equal to FULL's (bit-identical output)
runtime.note: a runtime row is 'runtime-only' when output is identical and the serial fps delta exceeds 2% of FULL and the two sides' fps ranges do not overlap; fps here is the serial whole-graph profile, not the double-buffer headline

single_roles.conflict: material positive on IDF1 or HOTA and no material negative on IDF1/HOTA/MOTA
single_roles.essential: material negative on IDF1 or HOTA and no material positive on IDF1/HOTA/MOTA
single_roles.no_material_quality_role: no material delta on any axis (role then rests on pairs, runtime, safety or dependency)
single_roles.trade_off: material negative on one quality axis and material positive on another
